name: model-guard
description: Choose the model versions Claude and its subagents may use: /models lists the newest of each family from Anthropic's Models API (older versions one key away); block a version, or a family's new ones, and subagents, workflows and /model asking for it are refused or moved to an allowed version. One list shared by every Claude Code window on the machine; a repo can keep its own.

defaultAllowed.title: Allowed by default
defaultAllowed.description: Read once, by the first 0.3 session, to seed the global list (the 0.2 setting): comma-separated families allowed (opus, sonnet, haiku, fable, other). After that, change things in /models.

fallback.title: Fallback model
fallback.description: Read once, to seed the global list: where requests on a blocked version go when their family has nothing allowed. After that, /models (f).

mode.title: Explicit asks for a model that is off
mode.description: Read once, to seed the global list. deny: refuse the spawn so Claude picks again; swap: run it on an allowed version. After that, /models (m).
